description: Create posts from an image the user provides (public URL). The image becomes the post's media and AI writes captions for it. Runs asynchronously — the user is notified when posts are ready.

count.description: Number of caption variants/posts to generate (default 1; only more when the user asks for more)

editPrompt.description: Exact image changes; takes precedence over generic enhancement. Topic only steers the caption.

enhance.description: Let AI regenerate an enhanced version of the image

imageUrl.description: Public HTTP/HTTPS URL of the image

topic.description: What the post should be about (helps the caption)

name: create_post_from_image
title: Create Post From Image
